simple.meaning: to tremble inwardly (or palpitate ), i.e. (figuratively) be (causative, make ) (suddenly) alarmed or agitated ; by implication to hasten anxiously

definitions.usage: be (make) affrighted (afraid, amazed, dismayed, rash), (be, get, make) haste(-n, -y, -ily), (give) speedy(-ily), thrust out, trouble, vex.
definitions.full: H926. bahal [ בָּהַל ] verb (Late Hebrew id. Passive participle בהול disquieted ; Pi`el disquiet ; ᵑ7 Pa`el בַּהֵיל hasten, be precipitate , also dismay: but is be quiet ) — Niph`al Perfect נִבְהַל 1Sam 28:21 ; נִבְהֲלָה Psa 6:4 ; נִבְהַלְתִּי Isa 21:3 ; וְנִבְהָ֑לְתִּי consecutive Job 21:6 ; נִבְהֲלוּ Gen 45:3 +, etc.; Imperfect וַיִּבָּהֵל Judg 20:41 ; 2 masculine singular תִּבָּהֵל Eccl 8:3 ; יִבָּהֵלוּ֑ן Psa 104:29 , etc.; Participle נִבְהָל 30:8 ; נִָֽבֳהָל Prov 28:22 ; feminine נִבְהָלָה Zeph 1:18 ; — 1 be disturbed, dismayed, terrified , Gen 45:3 (E) Judg 20:41 ; 1Sam 28:21 ; 2Sam 4:1 (|| יָדָיו וַיִּרְמּוּ , compare Ezek 7:27 above); of bones of sufferer Psa 6:3 (|| compare below 6:4 ); of hands of dismayed people Ezek 7:27 ; especially at chastisements & judgments of ׳י Exod 15:15 (song, in E) Psa 6:4 (subject נֶפֶשׁ , || compare above 6:3 ) Psalm 6:11 (|| בושׁ ) 30:8 ; compare 104:29 ; 83:18 (|| בושׁ ) 90:7 ; Isa 13:8 ; 21:3 (followed by מִן of occasion of fear) Job 23:15 ( id. ) Jer 51:32 ; Ezek 26:18 (strike out ᵐ5 Co); Job 4:5 (|| לאה ), compare also 21:6 as adjective terrible Zeph 1:18 אַךְנִֿבְהָלָה כָּלָה . 2 be in haste, hasty (late, compare Aramaic above): Eccl 8:3 ׳אַלתִּֿבּ תֵּלֵךְ מִמָּנָיו be not hasty (to) go from him ; Prov 28:22 לַהוֺן נִבֳהָל hastening after riches. Pi`el Imperfect וַיְבַהֵל Est 2:9 ; suffix יְבַהֲלֻהוּ Dan 11:44 ; וִיבַהֶלְךָ Job 22:10 ; יְבַהֲלֵמוֺ Psa 2:5 ; 2 masculine singular תְּבַהֲלֵם 83:16 ; אַלתְּֿבַהֵל Exod 5:1 ; 7:9 ; Infinitive suffix לְבַהֲלֵנִי 2Chr 35:21 ; םָ֯ 32:18 ; Particle מבלהים Kt, מְבַהֲלִים Qr Ezra 4:4 (BeRy prefix Kt, see בלהּ ); — 1 dismay, terrify , followed by suffix 2Chr 32:18 (|| ירא ), Dan 11:44 ; Job 22:10 (subject מַּחַד ), Psa 2:5 (subject ׳י ) 83:16 (|| רדף ; subject ׳י ); compare also Ezra 4:4 (see below בלהּ ). 2 hasten, make haste, act hastily (late), 2Chr 35:21 לְבַהֲלֵנִי אָמַר וֵאלֹהִים God hath given command to speed me (RVm); followed by infinitive make haste Est 2:9 ; of hasty speech Eccl 5:1 עַלמִּֿיךָ ׳אַלתְּֿב (|| דָבָר לְהוֺצִיא אַליְֿמַהֵר וְלִבְּךָ ); of anger 7:9 ׳אַלתְּֿב לִכְעוֺס בְּרוּחֲךָ . Pu`al Participle plural מְבֹהָלִים Est 8:14 , compare מְבֹהֶלֶת Qr Prov 20:21 (so read with Vrss Now Str; AV RV); Kt מבחלת see בחל ; — hastened Est 8:14 of royal posts (|| דְּחוּפִים ); hastily gained מְב ׳נַחֲלָה Prov 20:21 . Hiph`il Perfect suffix הִבְהִילָ֑נִי Job 23:16 ; Imperfect suffix וַיַּבְהִלוּהוּ 2Chr 26:20 ; 3 masculine plural וַיַּבְהִלוּ Est 6:14 ; — 1 dismay, terrify , followed by suffix Job 23:16 (subject שַׁדַּי ; || לִבִּי הֵרַךְ ). 2 (late) hasten, hurry (transitive), 2Chr 26:20 מִשָּׁם וַיַּבְהִלוּהוּ and they hurried him thence (|| נִדְחַף ); make haste , followed by infinitive Est 6:14 ׳וַיַּב לְהָבִיא and they make haste to bring Haman.
